name: moe-peer-review
description: Mixture of Experts peer review with 9 specialized personas (8 reviewers + 1 moderator). Four-phase structured deliberation: the moderator is a spawned agent observed by the main session, and the Huddle is grand rounds with direct persona-to-persona messaging, closed by a Reconciliation step that verifies what the Huddle produced and collects every persona's final stance.
